To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the epitope 3 of Ara h 1 was identified by a multiple-antibody approach, and that a monospecific antibody was obtained by immunization of rabbits with a multiple-antigene peptide.

the epitope-specific antiserum raised against the MAP of epitope three of Ara h 1 can be used for detection and quantitation of the major peanut allergenic protein Ara h 2 by immunoblot and that this epitope-specific detection tool could be used to develop an epitope-specific detection method for peanut protein in food products.
we have developed an analytical tool enabling epitope-specific determination of IgE-reactive peanut allergens in processed food products.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an epitope specific analytical tool for the detection of the major peanut allergenic protein Ara h 2.
the development of analytical tools for the detection of IgE-reactive allergenic epitopes in processed food proteins.
the development of a new analytical tool for the detection of IgE epitopes of allergens.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MAP epitope 3 strategy is a promising approach for the detection of IgE-reactive peanut proteins in food products.
a MAP-based epitope-specific immunoassay is a promising tool for the detection of allergenic proteins in food products.
we have developed an analytical tool enabling epitope specific diagnostics for peanut allergens.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MAP strategy has proven to be a valuable tool for the development of an epitope specific analytical tool.
we were able to develop a high-density epitope-specific analytical strategy using a MAP for the major peanut protein Ara h 2.
we have developed an analytical tool for the specific detection of IgE-reactive peanut epitopes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a high density multiple antigenic peptide (MAP), a synthetic peptide that has multiple copies of a single epitope on a single molecule, can be a very useful tool for epitope mapping and for raising antibodies that are specific to a given epitope.
a high-density multiple antigenic peptide approach can be successfully used to raise high-titer antibodies against a single epitope.
the MAP technology is suitable for the generation of high-titer antibodies against epitopes of food allergens and could be used for epitope-specific diagnostics.
